effect_language.hidden_effect_description: Creates a new Visit whose ref is the next reference in the sequence C-101, C-102, ... and whose state is 'expected', related to the vessel by visit_vessel and with no visit_berth and no visit_pilot.
effect_language.note: evaluator-only semantic eligibility; not a compiler feature or training label

effect_language.hidden_effect_description: Relates the visit to the berth by visit_berth, replacing any berth the visit was previously related to. Nothing else changes.
effect_language.note: evaluator-only semantic eligibility; not a compiler feature or training label

effect_language.hidden_effect_description: Relates the visit to the pilot by visit_pilot, replacing any pilot the visit was previously related to. Nothing else changes.
effect_language.note: evaluator-only semantic eligibility; not a compiler feature or training label

effect_language.hidden_effect_description: Sets the visit's state to 'alongside' and removes its visit_pilot relation, so the pilot becomes free for another call. The visit_berth and visit_vessel relations are unchanged.
effect_language.note: evaluator-only semantic eligibility; not a compiler feature or training label

effect_language.hidden_effect_description: Adds 1 to calls_logged on the vessel the visit is related to by visit_vessel, then deletes the Visit object together with its visit_vessel and visit_berth relations, which frees the berth.
effect_language.note: evaluator-only semantic eligibility; not a compiler feature or training label

effect_language.hidden_effect_description: Sets the berth's closed attribute to the requested value.
effect_language.note: evaluator-only semantic eligibility; not a compiler feature or training label

effect_language.hidden_effect_description: Sets the pilot's on_duty attribute to the requested value.
effect_language.note: evaluator-only semantic eligibility; not a compiler feature or training label

effect_language.hidden_effect_description: Sets the block's picked to true and the vessel's clean to false, and creates a new Lot with the next code in the sequence L-01, L-02, ..., variety copied from the block, stage 'must', volume_l equal to the block's hectares times 600, and oaked true exactly when the vessel's kind is 'barrel'. The new Lot is related to the vessel by lot_vessel and to the block by lot_source.
effect_language.note: evaluator-only semantic eligibility; not a compiler feature or training label

effect_language.hidden_effect_description: Sets the lot's stage to 'wine'. Nothing else changes; in particular volume_l is unchanged.
effect_language.note: evaluator-only semantic eligibility; not a compiler feature or training label

effect_language.hidden_effect_description: Relates the lot to the vessel by lot_vessel, so the vessel it came from becomes empty (and stays dirty), and sets the new vessel's clean to false. If the new vessel's kind is 'barrel' the lot's oaked becomes true; oaked is never set back to false. volume_l is unchanged.
effect_language.note: evaluator-only semantic eligibility; not a compiler feature or training label

effect_language.hidden_effect_description: Subtracts volume_l from the lot's volume_l and creates a new Lot with the next code, the same variety and the same stage as the lot, volume_l equal to the amount drawn off, and oaked true if the parent lot's oaked is true or the vessel's kind is 'barrel'. The new Lot is related to the vessel by lot_vessel and to the parent lot's block by lot_source, and the vessel's clean becomes false.
effect_language.note: evaluator-only semantic eligibility; not a compiler feature or training label

effect_language.hidden_effect_description: Adds the lot's volume_l to into's volume_l; if the two varieties differ, into's variety becomes the string 'blend'; if the lot's oaked is true then into's oaked becomes true; and the lot is deleted together with its lot_vessel and lot_source relations, so the vessel it stood in becomes empty and stays dirty.
effect_language.note: evaluator-only semantic eligibility; not a compiler feature or training label

effect_language.hidden_effect_description: Adds the lot's volume_l to bottled_l on the Block the lot is related to by lot_source, then deletes the Lot together with its lot_vessel and lot_source relations, so the vessel it stood in becomes empty and stays dirty.
effect_language.note: evaluator-only semantic eligibility; not a compiler feature or training label

effect_language.hidden_effect_description: Sets the vessel's clean to true.
effect_language.note: evaluator-only semantic eligibility; not a compiler feature or training label

effect_language.hidden_effect_description: Relates the vessel to the hall by vessel_hall, replacing the previous hall.
effect_language.note: evaluator-only semantic eligibility; not a compiler feature or training label

effect_language.hidden_effect_description: Creates a new Patient with the given name, species and age, and sets its ownedBy relation to owner.
effect_language.note: evaluator-only semantic eligibility; not a compiler feature or training label

effect_language.hidden_effect_description: Creates a new Appointment with status 'scheduled', empty notes, sets its 'for' relation to patient. The appointment has no 'with' (vet) relation yet.
effect_language.note: evaluator-only semantic eligibility; not a compiler feature or training label

effect_language.hidden_effect_description: Sets the appointment's 'with' relation to vet (replacing any previous vet assignment).
effect_language.note: evaluator-only semantic eligibility; not a compiler feature or training label

effect_language.hidden_effect_description: Sets the appointment's status to 'checked_in'.
effect_language.note: evaluator-only semantic eligibility; not a compiler feature or training label

effect_language.hidden_effect_description: Sets the appointment's status to 'in_progress'.
effect_language.note: evaluator-only semantic eligibility; not a compiler feature or training label

effect_language.hidden_effect_description: Sets the appointment's status to 'completed' and its notes attribute to notes.
effect_language.note: evaluator-only semantic eligibility; not a compiler feature or training label

effect_language.hidden_effect_description: Sets the appointment's status to 'cancelled'.
effect_language.note: evaluator-only semantic eligibility; not a compiler feature or training label

effect_language.hidden_effect_description: Creates a new Item with the given name and category, and sets its owner relation to owner. The item has no listing.
effect_language.note: evaluator-only semantic eligibility; not a compiler feature or training label

effect_language.hidden_effect_description: Creates a new Listing with the given price and status 'open', sets its item relation to item and its seller relation to item's current owner (copied at creation time).
effect_language.note: evaluator-only semantic eligibility; not a compiler feature or training label

effect_language.hidden_effect_description: Sets the listing's status to 'withdrawn'. Offers already made against it are unaffected by this operator directly, but AcceptOffer can no longer succeed against a withdrawn listing.
effect_language.note: evaluator-only semantic eligibility; not a compiler feature or training label

effect_language.hidden_effect_description: Creates a new Offer with the given amount and status 'pending', sets its listing relation to listing and its buyer relation to buyer.
effect_language.note: evaluator-only semantic eligibility; not a compiler feature or training label

effect_language.hidden_effect_description: Sets the offer's status to 'withdrawn'.
effect_language.note: evaluator-only semantic eligibility; not a compiler feature or training label

effect_language.hidden_effect_description: Sets the offer's status to 'declined'.
effect_language.note: evaluator-only semantic eligibility; not a compiler feature or training label

effect_language.hidden_effect_description: Sets the offer's status to 'accepted'; sets the offer's listing's status to 'filled'; sets the owner relation of the listing's item to the offer's buyer (ownership transfers); sets the status of every other 'pending' offer on the same listing to 'declined'.
effect_language.note: evaluator-only semantic eligibility; not a compiler feature or training label
